entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0046 'if' statement can be simplified - should be smarter #85995
  • Razor: custom snippet fields (`<Literal>` declarations) are inserted as plain text, with no tab stops #85988

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12309.278 #85989

PullRequests

Created

  • Indent list pattern contents relative to '[' when it starts its own line #85997
    Community, VSCode
  • Don't offer 'var' for an out argument when the call binds outside the checked member group #85996
    Community, VSCode
  • Don't track const locals in unused value analysis #85994
    Community, VSCode
  • Allow goto out of a block across a using declaration in that block #85993
    Community
  • Do not force a newline between } and , in switch expressions #85992
    Community, VSCode
  • Don't offer 'use pattern matching' when a local function writes the 'as' operand #85991
    Community, VSCode
  • [release/insiders] Backport ProjectData fixes to release/insiders #85990

Merged

  • Add src/ExpressionEvaluator to CODEOWNERS #85977
    Next

Updated

  • Let F# Find All References results carry pre-classified line text #85281
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Ensure unused BoundPassByCopy access evaluates all observable side effects #85986
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ParentTag binding for Tag Helpers inside plain HTML elements #85981
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Bound test runner output draining after process exit #85985
